title: A Warm Evening
setting: A park at sunset with a bench and a path.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie)

sentences.en: Mia and her brother Leo sit in the park.
sentences.zh: 米娅和哥哥里奥坐在公园里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and her brother Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) sit on a park bench at sunset.

sentences.en: The evening air is warm because the sun shines.
sentences.zh: 因为阳光照耀，傍晚的空气很温暖。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) relax on the bench in the evening, a low orange sun shining warmly over the park.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the low evening sun shining on the bench; the warm air and 'because' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Mia's homework is very difficult today.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) frowns at an open notebook on her lap and scratches her head.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia frowning at her notebook; how difficult the homework is can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Leo checks everything and finds the right answers.
sentences.zh: 里奥检查了所有题目，找出了正确答案。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) looks over the notebook of Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and puts ticks on the page with a pencil.

sentences.en: Mia's lunch bag includes two red apples.
sentences.zh: 米娅的午餐袋里有两个红苹果。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) opens a small lunch bag with two red apples inside.

sentences.en: Mia eats one apple, and Leo eats the other.
sentences.zh: 米娅吃了一个苹果，里奥吃了另一个。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) each bite into a red apple on the bench.

sentences.en: Somebody on a horse comes into the park.
sentences.zh: 有人骑着马走进了公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: A rider on a brown horse comes along the park path in front of Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) on the bench.

sentences.en: The horse is much taller than Mia.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) stands next to the brown horse and looks up at it; she is much shorter than the horse.
